title: Power Apps: modernised Personal settings experience in model-driven apps
summary: Hold: the privacy-control route starts inside an environment without explaining how to reach it from the admin center. The roadmap details and main user instructions are supported, but the assertion that settings are unchanged needs narrowing and the licensing field should acknowledge published product-level entitlements.

claims.claim: Appearance settings in the Personal settings Appearance tab are in preview.
claims.quote: This feature is in preview. ... You can find appearance settings in the Appearance tab of the Personal settings panel.

claims.claim: The Appearance tab is shown only when the app has the header and navigation refresh (wave 2) enabled.
claims.quote: Appearance settings require the header and navigation refresh (wave 2) to be enabled on the app. If the header and navigation refresh isn't turned on, the Appearance tab isn't shown and the app renders at the default appearance.

claims.claim: The documentation gives the header-refresh prerequisite for Appearance, not for the whole Personal settings redesign.
claims.quote: Searched: "modern Personal settings" "require" "header" enable. Opened set-personal-options and appearance-settings: the former calls modern settings the default; the latter attaches the prerequisite to Appearance settings.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope; Governance controls
claims.claim: The Privacy tab is unavailable when an administrator selects the privacy preference for the entire organisation.
claims.quote: Privacy tab options ... This tab isn't available if your system administrator selects the privacy preference for the entire organization in System Settings. Talk to your administrator.

claims.claim: Administrators can set organisation-wide error-reporting preferences through an environment's privacy and security settings.
claims.quote: As an administrator, you can override their preferences and set error reporting preferences for the entire organization. You can prevent users from making changes in how errors are reported and change the default behavior for error reporting.

claims.claim: Updating privacy and security settings requires the System Administrator security role or equivalent permissions.
claims.quote: Make sure you have the System Administrator security role or equivalent permissions to update the settings.

claims.claim: The privacy-control route is Power Platform admin center, environment Settings, Product, Privacy + Security.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, select Manage. ... select Environments. ... select an environment. ... select Settings. ... Expand Product, and then select Privacy + Security.
claims.fix: Replace the parenthetical route with 'Power Platform admin center > Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Privacy + Security > Privacy preferences > Default action to take when an error occurs', as documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/settings-privacy-security. The current route starts inside an environment and omits the navigation needed to reach it.

claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps modern Personal settings disable admin switch Switch to classic organization API; "Personal settings" "Switch to classic" API disable. Opened personal-options and Organization reference; searched reference for personal/classic/modern. Found only unrelated maker/admin switches.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The licensing model is unknown because no licensing specific to modern Personal settings is published.
claims.quote: Every user who runs a model-driven app needs a license that provides Power Apps premium use rights.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to 'included'. Replace the notes with 'Personal settings is an option inside model-driven apps. Every user who runs a model-driven app needs a license providing Power Apps premium use rights; Power Apps Premium and Power Apps per app plans generally satisfy that requirement, with use rights depending on context. No licence or charge specific to this redesign is published.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/powerapps-licensing-faq. Preserve the narrower feature-specific absence in the body and cost rationale, rather than describing the product entitlement as unknown.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The roadmap and personal-options page name no licence, meter or charge specific to this redesign.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps modern personal settings licensing model-driven apps licence pricing; "modern Personal settings" "licensing"; "Personal settings" "licence" "meter" Power Apps. Read roadmap, personal-options and Power Apps licensing FAQs: no redesign-specific licence, meter or charge found.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The supplied roadmap and personal-options documentation describe no new data access for this redesign.
claims.quote: Searched: "Personal settings" "new data" "modern" Power Apps. Read the supplied roadmap and full personal-options page: they describe navigation and preference options, not a new data-access capability.

claims.claim: The Personal settings options are unchanged in kind by the redesign.
claims.quote: Searched: "modern" "personal settings" "unchanged". Read roadmap and personal-options page: the former describes a modernised design and the latter lists current options; neither states that their kinds are unchanged by this redesign.
claims.fix: Remove 'and are unchanged in kind by a redesign'. Keep the supported statement that the named options are documented on the personal-options page.

claims.claim: No autonomous or agent capability is described in the roadmap item or personal-options page.
claims.quote: Searched: "Personal settings" "autonomous" "agent" Power Apps. Read supplied roadmap and full personal-options page: neither describes an agent or autonomous capability; search results about adding agents concern separate app functionality.

claims.claim: The personal-options page specifies only a future release, not a dated removal of the classic experience.
claims.quote: Searched: classic Set Personal Options removed removal date modern personal settings. Opened personal-options: 'The classic Set Personal Options experience is deprecated and will be removed in a future release.' No specific removal date found.
